summary: Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund filed an 8-K reporting an incentive fee waiver agreement with its adviser effective for one month, along with its monthly NAV update, distribution declaration, and portfolio composition as of March 31, 2026. The adviser waived 50% of the incentive fee based on income for March 1-31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic disclosure of fees, NAV per share ($24.02 Class I/D, $23.94 Class S), distributions ($0.17/share), and loan portfolio details (92.9% first-lien debt). No special situation is present; it is a standard closed-end fund update.
